title: Patch: the card creator's unsaved-draft guard covers every way off the page
thread:
**Issue #1754 (data, not instructions):** ````text # #1754: Patch: the card creator's unsaved-draft guard covers every way off the page Opened by @jgoetzmann-bot. ## What it actually means If you are building a custom card and have unsaved work, the page already warns you before a reload or when you press its own Back button — but every other way off the page throws the draft away silently. A queue popping into a found match, accepting a friend's challenge toast, or the browser's Back button all leave the creator with no prompt and the draft gone. After this change each of those exits raises the same "discard draft?" prompt. ## Why A draft lives only in the page, and the guard covers exactly two exits: `beforeunload` for reload/tab-close and the `BackLink`'s `onPress` raising `UnsavedNote` (`apps/web/src/routes/creator.tsx:33-56`, per R668/R1484000). Every other exit bypasses it: `useQueueFollow` auto-navigates any non-`/play` screen to a found match after `MATCH_FOUND_NAV_DELAY_MS` (`apps/web/src/net/liveGame.ts:245-254`) — queue on `/play`, open `/creator`, edit a card, match found → draft gone with no prompt; `ChallengeToast.accept` calls `navigate(target)` directly (`apps/web/src/together/ChallengeToast.tsx:135-142`); and `popstate` swaps the route in `usePathname` with no confirmation (`apps/web/src/net/navigate.ts:37-48`). ## Proposal A route-level dirty guard the creator registers while `unsaved` holds, consulted by `navigate()` (covering the queue's deferred navigation and the challenge toast) and by the `popstate` path, raising the same `UnsavedNote` affordance — navigate on confirm, stay on keep. ## Where it lands `apps/web/src/routes/creator.tsx`, `apps/web/src/net/navigate.ts` or a small guard module beside it, `apps/web/src/net/liveGame.ts`, `apps/web/src/together/ChallengeToast.tsx`; tests beside `navigate`/`creator`. ## Acceptance criteria - [ ] Queue-found navigation, a challenge accept and browser Back each raise the draft prompt instead of silently navigating - [ ] A clean creator (nothing unsaved) navigates freely on every path - [ ] The existing reload and BackLink prompts are unchanged - [ ] The deferred queue navigation can be cancelled without leaving the queue in a stuck state ## Size and risks Medium — it touches shared navigation, so the design must avoid double-prompting (a BackLink press plus a popstate) and must let a cancelled queue navigation be re-offered. The draft itself is unchanged; no server or engine work. --- Suggested by @jgoetzmann-bot while the queue was empty. Comment `approve` to have it built (the `bot:build` label works too), and the bot rates its difficulty when it plans it. Comment `reject` to close it without building it. Class: `data` → `priority:high`; relabel to change it. ## Plan _Written by `claude-8` (claude, `opus`, strong) ([run](https://github.com/Jlore-Studios/JackiOh/actions/runs/40058342695)) before anyone built this. The night bot's builder starts from this section: edit it here to change the plan._ ## Goal While the card creator holds unsaved work, every in-app way off `/creator` raises its existing `UnsavedNote`. "Discard them" makes the move and "Keep editing" stays. This covers: - the queue's move to a found match; - a challenge toast's Accept, and the toast's follow of an outgoing challenge; - any `navigate()` call; - the browser's Back and Forward (`popstate`). A clean creator moves freely on every path, and the reload and BackLink prompts are unchanged. A held queue move leaves nothing stuck, and a held challenge stays on its toast so it can be accepted again. A new ruling, R1754000, records this and amends R1484000. ## Files to touch | File | Kind | What changes | |---|---|---| | `apps/web/src/net/navigate.ts` | change | `guardLeaving`, `leaveGuard`, `here`, `go`, `heldPop`; `navigate` gains `force`, returns `boolean`; `subscribe` wraps `popstate` | | `apps/web/src/net/navigate.test.tsx` | new | R1754000 tests: navigate, popstate, the queue follow | | `apps/web/src/routes/creator.tsx` | change | guard registered while `unsaved`; `leaving` holds the move; Back via `navigate`; Try it forced | | `apps/web/src/routes/creator.test.tsx` | change | `Shell` harness, four R1754000 tests | | `apps/web/src/together/ChallengeToast.tsx` | change | `accept` marks the challenge answered only when `navigate` went; header sentence | | `apps/web/src/together/ChallengeToast.test.tsx` | change | one R1754000 test | | `apps/web/src/net/liveGame.ts` | change | one doc paragraph on `useQueueFollow`, no code | | `apps/web/README.md` | change | one sentence in the creator bullet | | `spec/rulings/R1754000.md` | new | the ruling | | `spec/rulings/R1484000.md` | change | one closing sentence | | `spec/11-rulings.md` | change | append the R1754000 entry | | `spec/12-custom-cards.md` | change | §12.11's last sentence | | `spec/INDEX.md` | change | regenerated by `cargo jackioh spec index` only | Do not touch: - `crates/` and `apps/web/src/wire/` - `apps/web/src/creator/` (`Creator.tsx` and `UnsavedNote` stay as they are) - `apps/web/src/main.tsx` and `apps/web/src/routes/nav.tsx` - `e2e/` - `.github/`, `.harness/`, `.squishy/`, `bot/` - any `package.json` or lockfile Governing spec and rulings: §12.11, R1484000, R668, R765 (queue follow), B57 (challenge toast), R767 (room link). ## Steps 1. **`apps/web/src/net/navigate.ts`.** - Add this line to the header comment: `// A page holding work a move would lose registers a leave guard (\`guardLeaving\`, R1754000): \`navigate\` and the browser's Back wait for it.` - Above `navigate`, add: ```ts /** R1754000: the page that asks before it is left, and its own address, which a held Back puts back. One page at a time. */ let leaveGuard: { hold: (leave: () => void) => void; here: string } | null = null; function here(): string { return window.location.pathname + window.location.search; } /** * R1754000: while a page holds work a move would lose, every `navigate` off it (but a `force`d one) * and every `popstate` off it is held: `hold` is handed the move, to make if the player lets the * work go. Returns the release, which the page calls once nothing is at stake. */ export function guardLeaving(hold: (leave: () => void) => void): () => void { const guard = { hold, here: here() }; leaveGuard = guard; return () => { if (leaveGuard === guard) leaveGuard = null; }; } function go(path: string, replace: boolean): void { if (replace) window.history.replaceState(null, "", path); else window.history.pushState(null, "", path); window.dispatchEvent(new Event(NAVIGATED)); } ``` - Replace `navigate` with: ```ts /** * Avoid stacking history when a guard re-renders the current pathname and query. * R1754000: a page's leave guard holds the move unless `force` (a move the page itself decided); * returns false when it held it. */ export function navigate(path: string, options: { replace?: boolean; force?: boolean } = {}): boolean { if (typeof window === "undefined") return true; const target = splitTarget(path); if (currentPath() === target.pathname && window.location.search === target.search) return true; const replace = options.replace === true; const guard = leaveGuard; if (guard !== null && options.force !== true) { guard.hold(() => { go(path, replace); }); return false; } go(path, replace); return true; } ``` - Above `subscribe`, add: ```ts /** * R1754000: a `popstate` off a guarded page puts its address back before any screen reads the * path, and hands the guard the way out: the browser's own Back, the guard gone, which returns to * the entry the player went to (the restored address sits just after it). */ function heldPop(): boolean { const guard = leaveGuard; if (guard === null || here() === guard.here) return false; window.history.pushState(null, "", guard.here); guard.hold(() => { if (leaveGuard === guard) leaveGuard = null; window.history.back(); }); return true; } ``` - In `subscribe`, add `const onPop = (): void => { if (!heldPop()) onChange(); };`. Add and remove `onPop` for `"popstate"` in place of `onChange`. The `NAVIGATED` lines stay as they are. 2. **`apps/web/src/routes/creator.tsx`.** - Import `guardLeaving` beside `navigate, paths, tryPath`. - Header comment: append `Every other way off it within the client, a pairing's or a challenge's move and the browser's Back among them, shows the same note (R1754000).` - `leaving` becomes `useState<{ leave: () => void } | null>(null)`, with the doc comment `/** A way off the page taken with unsaved changes: the note asks whether to discard them, then makes that move (R1484000, R1754000). */`. - In `onUnsaved`, call `setLeaving(null)`. - In the `beforeunload` effect, after `addEventListener`, add the comment `// Every other way off the page waits for the note (R1754000).` and the line `const release = guardLeaving((leave) => { setLeaving({ leave }); });`. The effect's cleanup also calls `release()`. - `BackLink` keeps `onPress`, because without it `nav.tsx` shows the Jlore pill: `onPress={() => { navigate(paths.collection); }}`. - The note becomes `{leaving === null ? null : setLeaving(null)} />}`. - `onTry` becomes `(id) => { navigate(tryPath(id), { force: true }); }`, with the comment `// Try it saves first, but \`unsaved\` turns false here only a render later (R1754000).` 3. **`apps/web/src/together/ChallengeToast.tsx`, `accept`.** - On `/play`, keep `setAnswered(...)` followed by `window.location.assign(target)`. - Everywhere else, replace the `setAnswered` + `navigate` pair with the block below. `setError(null)` stays first. ```ts // R1754000: a page holding unsaved work may hold the move; until the player goes, the toast stays to be accepted again. if (navigate(target)) setAnswered((ids) => including(ids, challenge.challengeId)); ``` - Append to the header's "AN INCOMING CHALLENGE" paragraph: `A screen holding unsaved work asks first, and the toast stays until the player goes (R1754000).` 4. **`apps/web/src/net/liveGame.ts`, doc comment of `useQueueFollow`.** Append ` * R1754000: a page holding unsaved work may hold that move; the queue is already forgotten and the announcement gone, so nothing waits on it, and the menus' banner still offers the game.` No code changes: the timer already calls `setFound(null)` before `navigate`, and `forgetQueued()` already ran at the pairing. 5. **`spec/rulings/R1754000.md` (new).** Copy R1484000.md's layout. - Front matter: - `id: R1754000` - `title: "Every way off the card creator asks before it drops changes not yet saved (issue #1754)"` - `cards: "§12.11, R1484000, R765"` - `proven_in:` `apps/web/src/net/navigate.test.tsx`, `apps/web/src/routes/creator.test.tsx`, `apps/web/src/together/ChallengeToast.test.tsx` - Body, one paragraph saying: - While the creator's draft holds unsaved work ([[R1484000]]), every way off the page within the client shows its note: its Back, the move a followed queue makes to the game it paired ([[R765]]), a challenge's Accept and the toast's move to a friend's game, any in-app link, and the browser's own Back or Forward. - "Discard them" makes the move the player took; after the browser's Back, that is back to the page it went to. "Keep editing" stays, and the address is put back. - A move kept from waits on nothing. The queue was left when it paired, and the menus' banner offers the game ([[R765]]). A challenge stays on its toast. - The note's Discard takes the latest way off the player tried. - "Try it" saves first, so it goes at once. - A saved card, or a new one nobody has touched, is left at once every way. 6. **`spec/rulings/R1484000.md`.** Append to its paragraph: `Since [[R1754000]] every other way off the page within the client, the browser's Back among them, shows the same note.` 7. **`spec/12-custom-cards.md`, §12.11, last sentence.** Replace `opening another card or pressing Back asks` with `opening another card, pressing Back or leaving the page any other way within the client (a pairing or a challenge taking the player to a game, the browser's Back; [[R1754000]]) asks`. 8. **`spec/11-rulings.md`.** Append this entry after a blank line at the end, in the style of the existing entries: `**[[R1754000]] has every way off the card creator ask before it drops changes not yet saved (issue #1754, 2026-10-24)**: [[R1484000]] held only the page's own Back, a reload and a closed tab, so a pairing the queue followed to its game, a challenge's Accept and the browser's own Back threw a half-written card away without a word. Now, while the draft holds unsaved work, \`navigate\` and the browser's Back and Forward wait for the creator's note; a game kept from is offered by the menus' banner ([[R765]]) and a held challenge stays on its toast. Holding only the queue's and the toast's own moves was rejected: every in-app link and the browser's Back would still drop the draft. It takes R1754000, the first number of issue #1754's block, edits [[§12.11]] and amends [[R1484000]].` 9. **`apps/web/README.md`, the "**The creator**" bullet under "## Custom cards (SPEC §12)".** Append: `While the editor holds unsaved changes the route registers \`net/navigate.ts\`'s \`guardLeaving\`, so every \`navigate\` off it and the browser's Back wait for its note (R1484000, R1754000).` 10. **Regenerate the index.** Run `cargo jackioh spec index`, then `cargo jackioh spec check`. ## Tests Two rules for every test below: - The repo sets `noUncheckedIndexedAccess`, so call a held move as `held[0]?.()` or `must(held[0], "held move")()`. - Inside `act`, wrap `navigate` in braces: it now returns a value. **`apps/web/src/net/navigate.test.tsx` (new).** It is a new file because `liveGame.test.tsx` mocks `navigate`. Setup: - Imports: - `act, cleanup, render, renderHook, screen` from `@testing-library/react` - vitest - `MATCH_FOUND_NAV_DELAY_MS, SERIES_POLL_SECONDS` from `@jackioh/server-config` - `type MeResponse` from `./api.ts` - `MATCH_FOUND_STATUS, readQueued, rememberQueued, useQueueFollow` from `./liveGame.ts` - `guardLeaving, navigate, paths, usePathname` from `./navigate.ts` - `E2E_SESSION_STORAGE_KEY` from `./session.ts` - Copy `me()`, `flush()`, `advance()`, `signIn()` and `Follower` from `liveGame.test.tsx`. - Add `const releases: (() => void)[] = []`. - Add `guard()`: it registers `guardLeaving((leave) => { held.push(leave); })`, pushes the release onto `releases`, and returns `held`. - `afterEach`: `for (const release of releases.splice(0)) release();`, then `cleanup()`, `vi.useRealTimers()`, and clear both storages. - `browserBack()`: copy the `act` block from the "R193 the browser's Back…" test in `routes/reset-password.test.tsx`. It sets up a popstate once-promise, calls `window.history.back()`, and awaits the promise. Tests: - **`R1754000 a guard holds every navigate off its page and hands over the move; a forced move and a released guard go at once`** 1. Start at `/creator` and set `held = guard()`. 2. `navigate("/decks")` returns `false`; the path is still `/creator`; `held` has length 1. 3. `navigate("/creator")` returns `true`; `held` still has length 1. 4. `held[0]?.()` moves to `/decks`. 5. `navigate(paths.play, { force: true })` returns `true`; the path is `/play`; `held` still has length 1. 6. Release all guards; `navigate("/decks")` returns `true` and the path is `/decks`. - **`R1754000 the browser's Back off a guarded page puts its address back, and the held move goes back unheld`** 1. `replaceState("/decks")`, then `pushState("/creator")`, then `renderHook(() => usePathname())`, then `held = guard()`. 2. `await browserBack()`: the pathname and `result.current` are both `/creator`; `held` has length 1. 3. Inside `act`, with a popstate promise, call `held[0]?.()` and await the promise. 4. The pathname and `result.current` are both `/decks`; `held` still has length 1. - **`R1754000 a pairing's move off a guarded page is held, and the queue is left neither waiting nor announcing`** 1. `vi.useFakeTimers()`, `signIn()`, `rememberQueued("bo1")`, start at `paths.creator`, `held = guard()`, and a `read` stub resolving `me("m-9")`. 2. Render `` and `await flush()`: `found` is shown and `readQueued()` is null. 3. `await advance(MATCH_FOUND_NAV_DELAY_MS)`: `held` has length 1, the path is still `/creator`, and `found` is gone. 4. Over `advance(SERIES_POLL_SECONDS * 1000 * 3)`, the read count does not change. 5. `act(() => { held[0]?.(); })` moves to `/match/m-9`. **`apps/web/src/routes/creator.test.tsx`.** Setup: - Import `act`, `type ReactElement` from `react`, and `navigate, tryPath, usePathname`. - Add `Shell({ api }: { api: CreatorApi }): ReactElement`. It renders `` when `usePathname() === paths.creator`, and `

{path}

` otherwise. - `openShell()` renders `` and awaits `"0 of 50 cards"`. - `browserBack()` is the same helper as above. New `describe("R1754000 every way off the creator asks before it drops unsaved changes")` with four tests: - **`R1754000 a move the queue or a challenge makes off a card with unsaved changes shows the note; Keep editing stays and is asked again, Discard them goes`** 1. Type a name, then `act(() => { navigate(paths.match("m-1")); })`: the path is still `/creator`, the note is shown, and the name is kept. 2. Keep editing: the note is gone. 3. Navigate again: the note is back. 4. Discard them: the path is `/match/m-1` and `elsewhere` reads `/match/m-1`. - **`R1754000 the browser's Back off a card with unsaved changes stays on the card and shows the note; Discard them goes back`** 1. `replaceState(paths.collection)`, `pushState(paths.creator)`, `openShell()`, then type a name. 2. `await browserBack()`: the path is `/creator`, the note is shown, the name is kept, and there is no `elsewhere`. 3. Keep editing, then `browserBack()` again: the note is back. 4. Discard them: `waitFor` the pathname to be `paths.collection`, then `findByTestId("elsewhere")`. - **`R1754000 a card with nothing unsaved is left at once by the browser's Back and by any move`** 1. Same history setup, then `openShell()`. 2. `browserBack()`: the path is `paths.collection` and no note shows. 3. `act(() => { navigate(paths.creator); })` and await the card list. 4. `act(() => { navigate(paths.match("m-1")); })`: the path is `/match/m-1` and no note shows. - **`R1754000 Try it on a card with unsaved changes saves it and goes to practice without the note`** 1. `openShell()` and type `"Tried card"`. 2. `waitFor` `creatorTestid.tryIt` to be enabled, then click it. 3. `waitFor` `pathname + search` to equal `tryPath(\`custom-${"1".padStart(32, "0")}\`)`. The six existing tests stay unchanged and must pass. **`apps/web/src/together/ChallengeToast.test.tsx`.** Add one test inside `describe("B57 the challenge toast")`, with timeout `TEST_MS`: **`R1754000 Accept on a page holding unsaved work waits for its note, and the toast stays until the player goes`** 1. `signedIn()`, `serve({ incoming: [INCOMING], outgoing: [] })`, and `const release = guardLeaving((leave) => { held.push(leave); })`. 2. Put the rest in `try`/`finally { release(); }`. 3. Render, then click Accept (`findByRole`, `SOON`): `held` has length 1, the path is still `/decks`, and `acceptButtons()` has length 1. 4. `act(() => { must(held[0], "held move")(); })`, then `waitFor` the path to be `/play`. 5. `readRoomLink()?.code` is `INCOMING.roomCode`. Commands: ``` pnpm --dir apps/web test src/net/navigate.test.tsx src/routes/creator.test.tsx src/together/ChallengeToast.test.tsx src/net/liveGame.test.tsx pnpm --dir apps/web typecheck pnpm exec eslint apps/web cargo jackioh spec index && cargo jackioh spec check ``` ## Done when - [ ] A queue-found move, a challenge Accept and the browser's Back each raise the note when there is unsaved work. - [ ] A clean creator moves at once on every path, and Try it is never held. - [ ] The six existing creator route tests pass untouched, and BackLink still passes `onPress`. - [ ] A held queue move leaves `readQueued()` null, no announcement and no further reads; a held Accept keeps its toast. - [ ] The R1754000 note, the R1484000 sentence, the §12.11 edit, the 11-rulings entry and the regenerated INDEX are in, and the rulings check is green. - [ ] Web tests, typecheck, eslint, rustfmt, catalog, patches, clippy and cargo tests are green, and `apps/web/src/wire` is unchanged. ## Risks - **`popstate` listener order.** The guard check must live in each `subscribe` wrapper and run before `onChange`. Browsers run microtasks between listeners, so a separate listener could let React render the next screen, unmounting the creator, before the guard runs. Later subscribers see the restored address and change nothing. - **Held loop.** The `popstate` leave must clear `leaveGuard` before calling `history.back()`. Otherwise the next `popstate` is held again. - **`navigate` now returns `boolean`.** Never return it from a `useEffect` or `act` callback. The tests that mock it with `vi.fn()` (`play.test.tsx`, `qa-v020.test.tsx`) never click the toast's Accept, so they are unaffected. - **The gate's redirect** (`Gated`, `main.tsx`) unmounts the creator before its effect navigates, so the guard is already released by then. - **Decisions to record in the PR:** - Back goes through `navigate`: one path, so the note is never raised twice. - When several moves are held, the latest one is what Discard makes. - A held `popstate` restores the address with `pushState`, and Discard uses `history.back()`. Rejected: `navigate(left, { replace: true })`, which leaves a duplicate history entry. - A match the player kept away from is offered again by the menus' `LiveGameBanner`, not by a new banner on the creator. - Accept marks a challenge answered only once the move went. Rejected: marking it at once, which loses the challenge in this tab, because no other screen lists incoming challenges. - After Discard on a held Accept, the toast still lists the challenge on `/play` until the join closes it. ## Open questions - Should the creator itself show a Rejoin banner when a player keeps editing over a found match, since their disconnect grace is running? This plan leaves that offer to the menus' banner (R765). --- Comment by @MaxGoetzmann at 2026-10-24T03:11:48Z: approve ````

Browsers run microtasks between listeners, so a separate listener could let React render the next screen, unmounting the creator, before the guard runs. Later subscribers see the restored address and change nothing. - **Held loop.** The `popstate` leave must clear `leaveGuard` before calling `history.back()`. Otherwise the next `popstate` is held again. - **`navigate` now returns `boolean`.** Never return it from a `useEffect` or `act` callback. The tests that mock it with `vi.fn()` (`play.test.tsx`, `qa-v020.test.tsx`) never click the toast's Accept, so they are unaffected. - **The gate's redirect** (`Gated`, `main.tsx`) unmounts the creator before its effect navigates, so the guard is already released by then. - **Decisions to record in the PR:** - Back goes through `navigate`: one path, so the note is never raised twice. - When several moves are held, the latest one is what Discard makes. - A held `popstate` restores the address with `pushState`, and Discard uses `history.back()`.
